Summary

COMEN01C is the Main Menu program for regular users in the CardDemo application. It displays a navigable menu screen, validates the user's menu selection, enforces access control by restricting admin-only options from regular users, and transfers control to the appropriate sub-program based on the user's choice. If no valid session exists, the user is redirected to the sign-on screen.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: None - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Session Validation - Check if a valid user session exists when the menu program starts. If no session data is present, redirect the user to the Sign-On screen to authenticate before accessing the menu. 2: Initial Menu Display - On the first visit to the main menu, initialize the screen and display the menu to the user with all available options populated and header information shown. 3: Menu Screen Input Capture - Capture the user's input from the main menu screen, including the option number they have entered. 4: Navigation Key Handling - Detect which key the user pressed (Enter, PF3, or other). If PF3 is pressed, return the user to the Sign-On screen. If an unrecognized key is pressed, display an invalid key error message and redisplay the menu. 5: Menu Option Input Validation - Validate the option number entered by the user. Ensure it is numeric, not zero, and within the valid range of available menu options. If invalid, display an error message prompting the user to enter a valid option number. 6: User Access Control Check - Verify that the logged-in user has permission to access the selected menu option. If the option is restricted to Administrators only and the current user is a Regular user, deny access and display a 'No access - Admin Only option' message. 7: Program Availability Check - For specific menu options (e.g., COPAUS0C), verify that the target program is installed and available in the system before attempting to navigate to it. If the program is not installed, display an error message indicating the option is not available. 8: Coming Soon Option Handling - If the selected menu option maps to a placeholder (DUMMY) program, display a 'coming soon' message to the user in green, indicating the feature is not yet available. 9: Menu Option Navigation - Transfer control to the appropriate program corresponding to the user's valid menu selection, passing along the session communication area so the target program knows the origin. 10: Return to Sign-On - Transfer the user back to the Sign-On screen, either when no session exists or when the user explicitly presses PF3 to log out or go back. 11: Header Information Population - Populate the menu screen header with application title, transaction ID, program name, current date, and current time to provide context to the user. 12: Menu Options Display Build - Dynamically build and display up to 12 menu option entries on the screen by combining each option's number and name into a formatted text line for each available menu item. 13: Error Message Display - Display appropriate error messages on the menu screen when validation fails, access is denied, a program is unavailable, or an invalid key is pressed, and redisplay the menu for the user to correct their input.

COMEN01
Tran: AWS Mainframe Modernization Date:mm/dd/yy Prog: CardDemo Time:hh:mm:ss Main Menu Please select an option : ENTER=Continue F3=Exit
Field Name Type Length Description
No field information available
1. MAIN-PARA – Initial Screen Display (First Entry) When the program is entered for the first time (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), it initializes the output map and sends the menu screen: ```cobol IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COMEN1AO PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN ``` 2. MAIN-PARA – Key Handling (Re-entry) On re-entry, the screen is received and the pressed key (EIBAID) is evaluated: ```cobol PERFORM RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 MOVE 'COSGN00C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM PERFORM RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` 3. SEND-MENU-SCREEN – Sends the BMS Map to the Terminal Populates header and menu options, moves the message to ERRMSG output field, then sends the map: ```cobol SEND-MENU-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO PERFORM BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COMEN1AO EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COMEN1A') MAPSET('COMEN01') FROM(COMEN1AO) ERASE END-EXEC. ``` 4. RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN – Receives User Input from the BMS Map Reads the user's input (selected option) from the terminal into COMEN1AI: ```cobol RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COMEN1A') MAPSET('COMEN01') INTO(COMEN1AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` 5. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO – Populates Header Fields on the Map Sets the transaction name, program name, title lines, current date, and current time into the output map fields: ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COMEN1AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COMEN1AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COMEN1AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COMEN1AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COMEN1AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COMEN1AO. ``` 6. BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS – Populates Menu Option Fields on the Map Loops through all defined menu options and places formatted text into OPTN001O through OPTN012O: ```cobol BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS. PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-IDX > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT MOVE SPACES TO WS-MENU-OPT-TXT STRING CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NUM(WS-IDX) DELIMITED BY SIZE '. ' DELIMITED BY SIZE CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(WS-IDX) DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MENU-OPT-TXT EVALUATE WS-IDX WHEN 1 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN001O WHEN 2 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN002O WHEN 3 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN003O WHEN 4 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN004O WHEN 5 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN005O WHEN 6 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN006O WHEN 7 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN007O WHEN 8 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN008O WHEN 9 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN009O WHEN 10 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN010O WHEN 11 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN011O WHEN 12 MOVE WS-MENU-OPT-TXT TO OPTN012O WHEN OTHER CONTINUE END-EVALUATE END-PERFORM. ``` 7. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Reads and Validates the OPTION Input Field Reads the user-entered option from OPTIONI, validates it, and echoes it back to OPTIONO: ```cobol PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM LENGTH OF OPTIONI OF COMEN1AI BY -1 UNTIL OPTIONI OF COMEN1AI(WS-IDX:1) NOT = SPACES OR WS-IDX = 1 END-PERFORM MOVE OPTIONI OF COMEN1AI(1:WS-IDX) TO WS-OPTION-X INSPECT WS-OPTION-X REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' MOVE WS-OPTION-X TO WS-OPTION MOVE WS-OPTION TO OPTIONO OF COMEN1AO IF WS-OPTION IS NOT NUMERIC OR WS-OPTION > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT OR WS-OPTION = ZEROS MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Please enter a valid option number...' TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN END-IF ``` 8. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Access Check and Error Message to ERRMSG Field If the user is a regular user trying to access an Admin-only option, an error is set and displayed via ERRMSGO: ```cobol IF CDEMO-USRTYP-USER AND CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(WS-OPTION) = 'A' SET ERR-FLG-ON TO TRUE MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE 'No access - Admin Only option... ' TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN END-IF ``` 9. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – "Coming Soon" and "Not Installed" Messages to ERRMSG Field Sets color and message on ERRMSGC/ERRMSGO for special program states: ```cobol WHEN CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION) = 'COPAUS0C' ... IF EIBRESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL) -- transfers control via XCTL ELSE MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHRED TO ERRMSGC OF COMEN1AO STRING 'This option ' DELIMITED BY SIZE CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(WS-OPTION) DELIMITED BY ' ' ' is not installed...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE END-IF WHEN CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION)(1:5) = 'DUMMY' MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COMEN1AO STRING 'This option ' DELIMITED BY SIZE CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(WS-OPTION) DELIMITED BY SPACE 'is coming soon ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE ```
